questions: Should the function follow links inside frames/iframes recursively, or only extract links from the top-level page's HTML?
Should duplicate hyperlinks be removed from the returned list, or should all occurrences be included?
Should the function handle JavaScript-generated links (e.g., links added via script after page load) or only static HTML?
Should the function extract hrefs from tags other than <a> (e.g., <link>, <area>, <base>)?
Should the function handle malformed href values (e.g., empty strings, JavaScript:void(0), mailto: links) and if so, how?
Should the function respect robots.txt or other crawl-delay directives?
Should the function handle authentication-required pages or cookies?
Should the function normalize URLs (e.g., remove trailing slashes, decode percent-encoding) before returning?
